facts.fact: 黑影还在喊名字——Keegan 捏紧她的手；「那不是 Rendel」的追问悬着。
facts.anchor: a shadowy figure calling my name

facts.fact: 声音模仿到声纹级：同样不耐烦、同样居高临下——父子听到的困惑一模一样。
facts.anchor: the same impatient tone, the same slightly condescending way of speaking

facts.fact: 举杖逼供成功：石头远早于学院与 Ward——「They were part of an older arrangement」（更老的秩序）。
facts.anchor: long before the Wards took the forms you recognize today

facts.fact: 「别想答案——它会知道」撞上「我没法控制想法」；影印烧、感传到手臂和胸口。
影印透衫发光并延伸出细紫光丝、铺满肩头成精致纹路——Keegan 让位给老妇看。
老妇指尖触皮即联机：远处石头骤亮、颜色与印相配；落叶卷飞——她缩手只憋出「Oh, dear」。
机制宣言：印不只是复刻刻纹——它在回应石头；三个词的答案让她退后一步。
裂缝沿石底爬行+银光出土：「No.」——灾变节奏用问答推进。
facts.anchor: a thin line of silver light emerged from the ground

facts.fact: 石头深呻吟、地面窄窄塌陷——反转成向下的石阶显形：灾难变邀请。
facts.anchor: a staircase appeared, leading down into the earth

facts.fact: 通道定位：「不该去的地方」；「Does it lead to Shadowick?」「Eventually, it could.」——Eventually 悬置。
facts.anchor: It’s an old passage to somewhere you shouldn’t go.

facts.fact: 地缘核弹：旧边界不在原地、Shadowick 不一直是 Shadowick；「Were the two villages connected?」「They still are.」
facts.anchor: What you see as Shadowick wasn’t always Shadowick.

facts.fact: 应答 Gidian 前被泼冷水：另一个声音你也认得——同一论证刚失效。
facts.anchor: That’s what you thought about the other voice

facts.fact: Gidian 蹲到开口旁：「你干了什么？」——她：为什么所有人都自动假设是我干的？
facts.anchor: Why does everyone automatically assume I’ve done something?

facts.fact: 互相僵住（熟悉？困惑？）→「Have we met?」「No. Not really.」——答得太快本身就是答案。
facts.anchor: The answer came quickly, too quickly.

facts.fact: 骑狼事全公开：Gidian「我不想再知道了」；「We don't have time for any of this.」
facts.anchor: He shifted, and I rode him

facts.fact: 老妇自我定义：花了非常长时间阻止某些事发生——和 Rendel 一样；Gidian 神色愈发凝重。
刻纹由紫转金、金光掠过 Gidian 指尖——「What in the world…」；光认人：紫印金 Gidian。
facts.anchor: instead of violet, they turned gold

facts.fact: 老妇盯着 Gidian：恐惧与相认并存——「You shouldn't be here. None of you.」
facts.anchor: both fear and recognition were part of it

facts.fact: 入口石壁刻着两个符号：肩上的影印＋髋上的蝴蝶印——「You weren't meant to have them both」（章尾双印炸弹）。
facts.anchor: One was the shadow mark on my shoulder.
